page: City page: B2B lead generation Delhi (/b2b-lead-generation-delhi)

items.question: Do we need to be based in Delhi to work with you?
items.answer: No. The entire engagement runs remotely, so wherever your team sits in NCR (or beyond), the system works the same way.

items.question: Do you only work with Delhi companies?
items.answer: No. We have clients across Delhi NCR, but we run outbound systems for B2B companies across India and internationally.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Most clients see their first qualified conversations within 3 to 4 weeks of kickoff, once ICP mapping, list building, and sequence setup are complete.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract.

items.question: Which Delhi NCR industries do you have the most experience with?
items.answer: Trading and export businesses, D2C and e-commerce brands, and enterprise-facing services firms are where we've run the most campaigns, but our system adapts to any B2B ICP.

items.question: What channels do you actually use to generate leads?
items.answer: Primarily cold email and LinkedIn outreach aimed at enterprise and trading-sector buyers, layered with account-based marketing to get past procurement gatekeepers on named target accounts, and AI-assisted list building and personalisation underneath all three. We pick the mix based on where your buyers actually spend their attention.

items.question: How is this different from hiring an in-house SDR?
items.answer: Hiring an in-house SDR in Delhi NCR means months of recruiting and ramp-up before they're fully productive, and even then, one person can only run so many sequences at once. A managed outbound system has multiple channels live within about three weeks, at a fraction of the fully loaded cost of a hire, and scales without you managing headcount.

items.question: What do you need from us to get started?
items.answer: A clear picture of your ICP (even a rough one works), access to a domain we can set up for outbound sending, and about an hour of your time for an onboarding call. We handle ICP refinement, list building, sequence writing, and day-to-day campaign management from there.

items.question: Do you cover Gurugram and Noida as well as Delhi?
items.answer: Yes. We run outbound for companies across Delhi NCR, including Gurugram, Noida and Faridabad. Gurugram and Noida also have their own pages on our site, but the team, process and pricing are the same wherever you sit in NCR.

items.question: How do I choose a lead generation agency in Delhi NCR?
items.answer: Ask four things: whether they have run campaigns for your industry, how they build and verify their lists, what they report each week (meetings and conversations, not just emails sent), and whether you can leave without a long contract. An agency that cannot show real case studies or promises a fixed number of leads before seeing your ICP is a warning sign.

items.question: Do you offer appointment setting for Delhi companies?
items.answer: Yes. Appointment setting is part of every engagement: we handle the replies and book qualified meetings straight into your calendar, so your sales team only joins calls with buyers who have agreed to talk.
